contexts.text: A religion which decrees... So, too, with some other things decreed of the Christian religion.
There hardly exists a nation so barbarous as not to have decreed by laws that murder is not to be committed...
A religion by which it is decreed that Divine Power belongs to a man.
(The notion that the Father and the Son) decree and decree who are worthy...
(And that) the rest may remain sons of wrath, as was before decreed.

These are the precepts, dogmas, and decrees of the modern Church concerning free will... They have been presented in order that the precepts, dogmas, and decrees of the New Church on these subjects may be more clearly seen.
They have decreed that man can contribute nothing...
They then poured forth and published their decree.
